industry.ipm: Indian pharmaceutical market (IPM) ₹2,565 bn in FY26, +9.9% (IQVIA, via Mankind AR FY26, as cited in the Abbott India file); ₹64,000-65,000 cr in the Mar-2026 quarter (GSK, 13-May-2026)
industry.ipmGrowth: Q1FY27 IPM +13.5% (IQVIA Jun-2026), 'fairly balanced between volume, price, and new introductions'; acute therapies are 60% of the market, chronic 40%; GSK's represented market grew 10% (Q1FY27 deck)
industry.pricing: Scheduled (NLEM) drugs: ceiling prices rise with the wholesale price index each April (+0.65% from 1-Apr-2026); others may rise up to 10% a year. ~40% of GSK India's business is price-controlled
industry.vaccines: GSK leads the private (self-pay) paediatric vaccine market (26.1% value share, IQVIA Jun-2026); adult vaccination is a new category in India (Shingrix ~₹100 cr a year; Arexvy authorised 2026)
industry.oncology: Oncology was the fastest-growing IPM therapy in Q1FY27 (+27%, MD); India has ~1,000 medical oncologists; 18,000 new multiple myeloma patients a year, 40,000-45,000 prevalent (GSK)
industry.mnc: MNC pharma in India (Abbott India, GSK, Sanofi, Pfizer) run asset-light models with high payouts and parent-sourced portfolios; GSK is #2 among MNCs by value (IQVIA MAT Mar-2026)

strengths: Brands doctors trust for decades: Augmentin (#3 in the IPM), Calpol (~1/3 of paracetamol), T-Bact (57.5% share), Ceftum, Betnovate, Eltroxin
Leadership in private paediatric vaccines and first-mover position in adult vaccination (Shingrix, Arexvy)
Access to GSK plc's global pipeline with a 6-8 month launch lag now (Blenrep, Jemperli, bepirovirsen), no royalty disclosed
Asset-light, debt-free, ROE above 40%, ₹2,755 cr of cash
weaknesses: ~40% of the business under price control
General medicines (80% of revenue) grew ~5% a year for a decade; antibiotics and paracetamol are crowded
Concentrated supply chain: one CMO fire cost more than ₹100 cr of FY26 sales
Innovation assets are imported, need patient-assistance programmes and are still only 7% of sales

critiques: Revenue grew only 5.5% a year in FY21-26 (2% in FY26); the 12-13% growth needed for ₹8,000 cr has never been delivered
GAM; analyst questions on the Q4FY26 call (13-May-2026)
Margin expansion (EBITDA 20% → 34% in five years) came from mix, pricing, sourcing and restructuring; management now says it will hold margins and reinvest
~40% of the portfolio is price-controlled (NLEM); a new list could add more large brands, as in 2022
Innovation is 7% of sales and depends on self-pay patients and patient-assistance programmes; public 'CARE' accounts not yet unlocked
Supply concentration: the Apr-2025 CMO fire cut FY26 general-medicine growth to ~0%
History of value-destroying one-offs: Vemgal plant (~₹890 cr of impairments), Zinetac recall, VRS; and a ₹1,649 cr brand sale to a GSK group company
Valuation: 37x FY28E on our EPS; Motilal Oswal sees limited upside (35x)
gaps: GSK India does not report revenue by business (general medicines, vaccines, specialty) or by brand; we use quarterly 'innovation %' disclosures and statements on calls (general medicines 75-80%+, vaccines +11-12% in FY26)
FY26 innovation revenue (~₹190 cr) is our estimate from 4% (Q1FY26) and 6% (Q4FY26) of quarterly sales; Q2-Q3FY26 shares were not disclosed
No consensus EPS published by 30-Sep-2026 was found; ICICI Securities' Nov-2025 note was read only via a listing and a press summary (method not disclosed); Nirmal Bang's note is from Aug-2025
Business Standard pages on GSK Pharma (Oct-2025, Nov-2025 broker roundups) returned HTTP 403 to automated access; not bypassed

We did not fetch Screener data for Pfizer, Sanofi India or AstraZeneca Pharma (MNC peers): the house fetch script sends a browser-like user agent, which this task's rules forbid; the MNC comparison uses Abbott India only
The cause of the late-August 2026 rally (₹2,600 to ₹3,106 on heavy volume) was not found in company announcements or press we could read
NLEM share of the portfolio is given three ways (35-38%, ~40%, 44-45% of general medicines); no audited figure
Shingrix, Nucala, Trelegy and oncology revenues are not disclosed individually beyond 'Shingrix crossed ₹100 cr MAT' and 'oncology ~₹10 cr a month'
EV history: net cash between year-ends is held at the March figure less the final dividend from August; half-year balance sheets not used
conflicts: Screener classifies GSK's gains on liquid mutual funds (₹79.6 cr in FY26, ₹69.6 cr in FY25) as exceptional items and shows FY22's discontinued-operations profit (₹1,314 cr) inside other income; we use the company's notes (other income ₹145.4 cr in FY26; exceptional items ₹20.6 cr)
General medicines' share of revenue: 'more than 80%' (AR FY26) vs '75%-78%' (Q3FY26 call); we use ~80% including the distributed portfolio

Standalone (company) vs consolidated figures: Q1FY27 revenue ₹924 cr / +15% (standalone, company press release) vs ₹938 cr / +16.5% (consolidated); PAT ₹253 cr standalone includes a one-off dividend from Biddle Sawyer, consolidated PAT ₹237 cr. We model consolidated
